import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom' import Button from '../Button' import Tag from '../Tag' import { Card, Descricao, Titulo, Infos, Imagem, Conteudo, Nota } from './styles' import star from '../../assets/images.nova/star.svg' type Props = { title: string description: string infos: string[] image: string nota: number key: number // Adicionando o ID do prato } const Product = ({ description, image, infos, title, nota, key }: Props) => { const navigate = useNavigate() const handleNavigate = () => { navigate(`/prato/${key}`) // Navega para a página de detalhes do prato com o id } return ( {infos.map((info) => ( {info} ))}
{title} {nota}
{description} ) } export default Product
